lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region. Primary clusters are organized into horizontal rows with larger spots occupying the mid-flank and smaller, denser spots occurring more dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal luminance gradients to form a lattice; high-luminance circular blobs are positioned precisely at the nodes of these vertical and horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with a light-toned upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density concentration of small, high-luminance spots is visible on the anterior cephalic region, exhibiting a more stochastic distribution compared to the ordered grid-like pattern of the posterior flank.
